The 30 simulation designs of Hanif, Iqbal and Choudhary (2017)

Source: R/simulate.R
mhp_designs.Rd

mhp_designs() lists the 30 combinations of Table 1 of the paper: five ratios \(\sigma_\varepsilon / \sigma_\delta\) of the standard deviations of the trend and cycle shocks (10, 5, 2, 1, 0.5) crossed with six AR(2) cycles \((\phi_1, \phi_2)\): (0.9, 0.01), (1.2, -0.25), (1.2, -0.4), (1.2, -0.55), (1.2, -0.75) and (0.8, 0). The designs of Choudhary, Hanif and Iqbal (2014, Table 1) have the same cycles and the ratios 10, 5, 1, 0.5 and 0.01.

Usage

mhp_designs(paper = c("2017", "2014"))

Arguments

paper

"2017" (default, Hanif et al.) or "2014" (Choudhary et al.).

Value

A data.table with the columns model (1 to 30, as in the paper), sd_ratio, ar1, ar2.

References

Choudhary, M. A., Hanif, M. N. and Iqbal, J. (2014). On smoothing macroeconomic time series using the modified HP filter. Applied Economics, 46(19), 2205–2214. doi:10.1080/00036846.2014.894631

Hanif, M. N., Iqbal, J. and Choudhary, M. A. (2017). Fully modified HP filter. SBP Working Paper Series, No. 88, State Bank of Pakistan.

See also

mhp_simulate, fmhp_simulation

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

mhp_designs(
    paper = "2017"
  )
